claim: The port/splitter is drivable and readable through micromanager: it can be set without a human and its position can be read back. It is an element of a channel that is automatable in full with read-back, and the earlier record of a manual-only splitter with no programming interface was wrong on every field it asserted.
validity_conditions: This instrument as configured on 2026-09-17, operator read at the instrument. Drivable and readable is not the same as verifiable: read-back returns a position, and which element that position holds is exactly what is unknown (see csuw1_port_slots). Falsified by a driver or configuration change that drops the property.
